commentary.text: 90+9' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+8' Having seen unsporting behavior, Tim Robinson shows a yellow card to one of the players sitting on the bench. And Joao Gomes (Wolves) is the recipient.
90+8' Rayan Ait Nouri (Wolves) gets a yellow card, off the field.
90+7' 2 - 1 Goal! A precise cut back on the goal line from Pablo Sarabia finds Mario Lemina (Wolves) right in front of goal, and he easily buries the ball into the bottom left corner. 2:1.
90+6' It's a yellow card for Matt Doherty (Wolves).
90+5' Craig Dawson (Wolves) gets booked for the first time in this match.
90+3' Tim Robinson blows his whistle as Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.

90+1' 1 - 1 It's a goal! Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) scores with a brilliant shot into the left side of the goal after being released inside the box by a superb lofted pass from Matheus Cunha. The score is now 1:1.
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
89' Booking. Rodrigo Bentancur (Tottenham) receives a caution from the referee.
89' Tottenham take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
88' Giovani Lo Celso (Tottenham) does well to control a poor pass on the edge of the box then shoots towards the top right corner. Jose Sa is out of position but leaps to make a brilliant save.
87' Gary O'Neil has decided to substitute Rayan Ait Nouri and he is replaced by Thomas Doyle (Wolves).
87' We are about to witness a substitution. Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) is replacing Joao Gomes.
85' The resulting corner from Rayan Ait Nouri (Wolves) is cleared by the defence.
84' Rayan Ait Nouri (Wolves) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
80' Mario Lemina (Wolves) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out.
78' Jose Sa (Wolves) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
77' Jose Sa (Wolves) picks up an injury.
76' Yves Bissouma goes off the pitch and Giovani Lo Celso (Tottenham) comes on.
75' Ange Postecoglou has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Bryan Gil (Tottenham) replacing Brennan Johnson.
73' Today's match ends for Jean-Ricner Bellegarde who will be replaced by Sasa Kalajdzic (Wolves).

72' What a chance that is! Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) finds himself unmarked in a promising position after receiving a cross on the edge of the box and his attempt sails a whisker wide of the right post.
71' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) commits a foul and Tim Robinson immediately signals a free kick.
70' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) serves up a nice cross, but Jose Sa punches the ball away.
69' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.

68' Pierre-Emile Hojbjerg (Tottenham) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Tottenham will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
67' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
67' Gary O'Neil prepares a substitution. Nelson Semedo is replaced by Matt Doherty (Wolves).
63' A substitution has been made. Pape Matar Sarr goes off and Rodrigo Bentancur (Tottenham) comes on.
62' Wolves will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
61' Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Wolves) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.
61' Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Wolves) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man. The referee points to the corner flag and Wolves will take a corner.
60' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) commits a rough foul. Tim Robinson stops the game and makes a call. Wolves win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
59' The ball is out of play and Wolves manage to earn a corner.
58' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 13:3.
55' Wolves force their opponents to concede a corner.
53' A wild effort from Matheus Cunha (Wolves) on the edge of the box flies well wide of the right post.
51' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
46' Referee Tim Robinson blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+6' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+6' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
45+4' Yves Bissouma (Tottenham) receives a yellow card.
45+2' Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Wolves) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
45+2' The ball goes out of play. Wolves are awarded a corner kick.

45+2' Joao Gomes (Wolves) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders. It will be a corner kick for Wolves.
45+1' It seemed like Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Wolves) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
45' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
45' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Emerson Royal (Tottenham) was quite harsh and Tim Robinson didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
43' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) plays a through ball but overhits it. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Wolves.
39' The ratio of the ball possession is 40:60.
35' Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Wolves) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
35' Wolves earn a corner.
34' Rayan Ait Nouri (Wolves) will deliver the corner kick.

33' Guglielmo Vicario was forced into action to thwart Mario Lemina (Wolves). He found himself some space after latching on to a pass and unleashed a shot to the bottom left corner but couldn't beat the keeper. The referee signals a corner kick to Wolves.
30' Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Jose Sa intercepts the ball.
27' Rayan Ait Nouri (Wolves) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target.
26' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Tim Robinson blows his whistle for a foul.
23' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) is able to continue to play.
21' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
19' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
17' Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Wolves) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
16' Rayan Ait Nouri (Wolves) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat. Wolves get a corner.
14' Mario Lemina (Wolves) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
12' Looks like Mario Lemina (Wolves) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
11' Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Wolves) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.

10' Rayan Ait Nouri (Wolves) collects a brilliant pass inside the box and finds himself in a goal scoring opportunity. He takes a shot, but the effort is well blocked by one of the defending players. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Wolves.
9' Joao Gomes (Wolves) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a precise pass. He pulls the trigger but only hits one of the opposition, who gets in the way of his effort.
7' The foul by Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves) was seen by Tim Robinson who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
6' Some great controlled play and passing from Tottenham. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
3' 0 - 1 Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) received a delightful pass inside the box before slotting the ball past the goalkeeper. What a brilliant finish!
1' The first half has started.
The players are on the pitch and Wolves will have the kick-off.
Tim Robinson got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
